${params.dataScope} and ap.type = '1' and ap.type = '2' and ap.type = '3'

order by ap.update_time desc

insert into anchor_point ( customer_id, customer_nm, identity, type, anchor_name, anchor_type_code, anchor_type, address_desc, update_time, lon, lat, address_type, belong_grid_name, belong_grid, belong_grid_type, area_code, belong_org_code, belong_org_name, customer_phone, create_time, belong_manager_code, belong_manager_name, grid_manager) values

mapper.update: update anchor_point ap,performance_customer_info pci set ap.customer_id = pci.id,ap.anchor_name = pci.customer_name,ap.customer_phone = pci.customer_phone,ap.belong_manager_name = pci.credit_manager where DATE_FORMAT(ap.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = CURDATE() and ap.type = 1 and ap.customer_nm = pci.customer_nm and pci.credit_manager_job_number = ap.belong_manager_code

update anchor_point ap,performance_customer_info pci set ap.customer_id = pci.id,ap.anchor_name = pci.customer_name,ap.customer_phone = pci.customer_phone,ap.belong_manager_name = pci.credit_manager where ap.type = 1 and ap.customer_nm = pci.customer_nm and pci.credit_manager_job_number = ap.belong_manager_code

update anchor_point ap,credit_customer_info cci set ap.customer_id = cci.id,ap.anchor_name = cci.customer_name,ap.customer_phone = cci.customer_phone,ap.belong_manager_name = cci.credit_manager where DATE_FORMAT(ap.create_time,'%Y-%m-%d') = CURDATE() and ap.type = 2 and ap.customer_nm = cci.customer_nm and cci.credit_manager_job_number = ap.belong_manager_code

update anchor_point ap,credit_customer_info cci set ap.customer_id = cci.id,ap.anchor_name = cci.customer_name,ap.customer_phone = cci.customer_phone,ap.belong_manager_name = cci.credit_manager where ap.type = 2 and ap.customer_nm = cci.customer_nm and cci.credit_manager_job_number = ap.belong_manager_code

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT cr.product_name AS productName, cr.create_time AS creditCreateTime, cr.expire_date AS expireDate, cr.credit_amount AS creditAmount, cr.loan_amount AS loanAmount, cr.manager AS manager, RIGHT(ocr.card_num, 4) AS cardNum, ocr.card_type AS cardType, ocr.create_time AS openCardCreateTime, cv.visits_manager AS visitsManager, cv.visits_time AS visitsTime FROM credit_record cr LEFT JOIN opening_card_record ocr ON cr.custom_id = ocr.custom_id LEFT JOIN customer_visits cv ON cv.customer_id = cr.custom_id WHERE cr.custom_id = #{customerId} AND cr.type = #{type} ORDER BY cr.custom_id
SELECT customer_identity FROM performance_customer_info WHERE customer_nm = ( SELECT customer_nm FROM anchor_point WHERE ap.id = #{anchorPointId} )

select * from anchor_point where customer_id = #{id} and type = 3

select * from anchor_point where belong_grid = #{s}

SELECT a.id,a.customer_id,a.lon,a.lat, #{customerType} as custom_type,su.user_id, su.dept_id,sd.ancestors,su.manager_num,pait.ancestor_codes, c.custom_group_id FROM custom_group_customer c LEFT JOIN anchor_point a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id left join sys_user su on a.belong_manager_code = su.manager_num left join sys_dept sd on su.dept_id = sd.dept_id left join pa_addr_info_type pait on pait.code = a.belong_grid where a.lon is not null and c.custom_group_id = #{groupId} limit #{startIndex},#{endIndex}
where customer_nm = #{nm} and TYPE = #{type}

select id, name, admin_code as code, lon, lat, address, case when name like concat(#{addressDesc}, '%') then 1 else 2 end as sort from pa_poc_address where address like concat('%', #{addressDesc}, '%') or name like concat(#{addressDesc}, '%') order by sort asc limit 50;
select anchor_name, address_desc, lon, lat, belong_grid, belong_org_code from anchor_point where anchor_name like concat('%', #{anchorName}, '%') or anchor_name like concat(#{anchorName}, '%')

select t3.name as threeGrid, t2.name as fourGrid, t1.name, t1.code, t1.addr_level, t1.center_point from pa_addr_info_type t1 LEFT JOIN pa_addr_info_type t2 ON t1.parent_code = t2.code LEFT JOIN pa_addr_info_type t3 ON t2.parent_code = t3.code where t1.name like concat('%', #{branchName}, '%') or t1.name like concat(#{branchName}, '%')

and anchor_name like concat('%',#{anchorName},'%')
